survivorsTest.conclusion: No organisation found serves HIA survivors as children: every HIA-specific body (WAVE HIA, Advice NI, SAVIA, Survivors North West) works with adults abused as children, and none appears in any children's network list found. Two (WAVE, Aisling) tick children on the register for other services. COSICA/Redress therefore corresponds to an adult-survivor VCS, not to the children's sector.

None of the three is on the CCNI children-filtered register.
